definitions.ask: Should the built-in fallback box, shown only when no saved default fits any screen, become near-fullscreen?
definitions.why: The fallback is rare once a default is saved, so keep this change limited to the Enter keys

choices.label: Leave the centered 60% fallback; Bryan sets his near-fullscreen default once with ⌘Enter
Make the fallback a centered 90% box, so a fresh or off-screen default also opens near fullscreen
